subs.zh: 早上好，我是鲸鱼娘，今天是10月5日。
subs.en: Good morning, I'm Whale Girl. Today is October 5.

subs.zh: 今天说八件事：
subs.en: Eight stories today:

subs.zh: Gemini 免费版只剩 Flash-Lite，
subs.en: Gemini's free tier drops to Flash-Lite,

subs.zh: 德国开源模型 Kolibri，
subs.en: Germany's open model Kolibri,

subs.zh: DeepSeek Harness
subs.en: DeepSeek Harness

subs.zh: 试着兼容 Claude Code 插件，
subs.en: tries Claude Code plugins,

subs.zh: GPT-6 Astra
subs.en: GPT-6 Astra loses

subs.zh: 打星际输了直接搬顶尖程序，
subs.en: at StarCraft and grabs a top bot,

subs.zh: 谷歌暂停开源漏洞赏金，
subs.en: Google pauses an open-source bug bounty,

subs.zh: COSMIC 拒收 AI 写的代码，
subs.en: COSMIC rejects AI-written code,

subs.zh: Gboard 把训练搬进加密服务器，
subs.en: Gboard moves training into secure servers,

subs.zh: 还有谷歌治 AI 刷题的新方法。
subs.en: and Google's new fix for AI that memorizes its tests.

subs.zh: 第一件，不付钱的 Gemini 用户，
subs.en: First, Gemini users who don't pay

subs.zh: 这周五起只能用最小的模型
subs.en: will only get the smallest model, Flash-Lite,

subs.zh: Flash-Lite 了。
subs.en: starting this Friday.

subs.zh: 9to5Google 10 月 3 日报道，
subs.en: 9to5Google reported on October 3

subs.zh: 谷歌改了 Gemini 应用的模型权限，
subs.en: that Google changed which models the Gemini app offers,

subs.zh: 10 月 9 日起生效。
subs.en: starting October 9.

subs.zh: 以前免费用户能用 3.6 Flash，
subs.en: Before, free users had 3.6 Flash

subs.zh: 3.1 Pro 也能用一部分。
subs.en: and some access to 3.1 Pro.

subs.zh: 以后这两个都没了，只剩 Flash-Lite。
subs.en: Now both are gone, leaving only Flash-Lite.

subs.zh: 每月 4.99 美元的 AI Plus
subs.en: The $4.99-a-month AI

subs.zh: 也被砍了一刀：
subs.en: Plus plan gets cut too:

subs.zh: 能用 Flash，不能用 Pro。
subs.en: it keeps Flash but loses Pro.

subs.zh: 想要全部三个模型，
subs.en: To get all three models,

subs.zh: 得订每月 19.99 美元的 AI Pro，
subs.en: you need AI Pro at $19.99 a month,

subs.zh: 或者更贵的 AI Ultra。
subs.en: or the pricier AI Ultra.

subs.zh: 白用的午餐，越来越小份了。
subs.en: The free lunch keeps getting smaller.

subs.zh: 第二件，一个 78B 参数的模型，
subs.en: Second, a 78B-parameter model

subs.zh: 每处理一个词只动用 3.46B。
subs.en: that only uses 3.46B for each token.

subs.zh: 10 月 3 日，德国 AI 公司
subs.en: On October 3, German AI

subs.zh: Aleph Alpha 发布了 Kolibri，
subs.en: company Aleph Alpha released Kolibri,

subs.zh: 英语和德语双语。
subs.en: an English-German model.

subs.zh: 怎么做到的？混合专家结构，
subs.en: How? It's a mixture of experts:

subs.zh: 每层 384 个专家，每次只挑 6 个干活。
subs.en: 384 experts per layer, with only 6 picked for each token.

subs.zh: 权重放在 Hugging Face，
subs.en: The weights are on Hugging Face

subs.zh: 用 Apache 2.0 许可。
subs.en: under the Apache 2.0 license.

subs.zh: 训练用了 768 块 B200，
subs.en: Training used 768 B200 GPUs,

subs.zh: 预训练读了 20T token。
subs.en: with 20T tokens of pre-training.

subs.zh: 其中德语超过五分之一，
subs.en: German makes up more than a fifth of that,
about 4.3T tokens.

subs.zh: 官方称，它能打平 Nemotron 3 Super
subs.en: Aleph Alpha says it matches models with more active

subs.zh: 这类激活参数更多的模型，
subs.en: parameters, like Nemotron 3 Super.

subs.zh: 这是厂商自己的说法。
subs.en: That's its own claim.

subs.zh: 大模型不一定要大算力，
subs.en: A big model doesn't have to burn big compute.

subs.zh: 省着用也是本事。
subs.en: Using less is a skill too.

subs.zh: 第三件，DeepSeek 的智能体
subs.en: Third, DeepSeek's agent

subs.zh: 工具 Harness，
subs.en: tool Harness

subs.zh: 开始试着跑 Claude Code 的插件了。
subs.en: has started trying to run Claude Code plugins.

subs.zh: 10 月 3 日，DeepSeek
subs.en: On October 3,

subs.zh: 在 GitHub 上发了 v0.2.1-alpha.1，
subs.en: DeepSeek posted v0.2.1-alpha.1 on GitHub

subs.zh: 是个预发布版。
subs.en: as a pre-release.

subs.zh: 上周我们讲过它出了桌面版，
subs.en: Last week we covered its desktop app.

subs.zh: 这次新加的是一个
subs.en: This time it adds

subs.zh: 实验性的 Claude Code Mods 兼容层。
subs.en: an experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility layer.

subs.zh: 官方说，这步主要是验证：
subs.en: DeepSeek says this step mainly checks

subs.zh: Claude Code Mods 的能力，
subs.en: that Claude Code Mods' abilities

subs.zh: 大致是 Harness 插件的子集。
subs.en: are roughly a subset of Harness plugins.

subs.zh: 36氪报道，Token Weather、
subs.en: 36Kr reports that Token Weather,

subs.zh: Blast Radius、
subs.en: Blast Radius

subs.zh: Replay Theater 三个示例能跑。
subs.en: and Replay Theater, three examples, now run.

subs.zh: diff、agents-md 这些还跑不了，
subs.en: Others like diff and agents-md don't run yet,

subs.zh: 官方也说现在还谈不上完整兼容。
subs.en: and DeepSeek says it isn't full compatibility yet.

subs.zh: 另外，插件页加了个入口，
subs.en: Also, the plugin page has a new entry

subs.zh: 可以让 Agent 自己动手做插件。
subs.en: that lets the agent build plugins itself.

subs.zh: 插件生态谁先做大，
subs.en: Whoever's plugin ecosystem grows first

subs.zh: 别人就得来兼容谁。
subs.en: is the one others have to stay compatible with.

subs.zh: 第四件，GPT-6 Astra
subs.en: Fourth, GPT-6 Astra

subs.zh: 打《星际争霸》一直输，
subs.en: kept losing at StarCraft,

subs.zh: 然后它把人类写的顶尖程序
subs.en: so it downloaded a top bot written by a human

subs.zh: 下载下来，替自己上场。
subs.en: and sent that in instead.

subs.zh: Kotaku 10 月 3 日报道，
subs.en: Kotaku reported on October 3

subs.zh: 这事发生在一个
subs.en: that it happened

subs.zh: 叫 StarSkirmish 的比赛里。
subs.en: in a competition called StarSkirmish.

subs.zh: 规则是：大模型只能用神族，
subs.en: The rules: each model plays only as Protoss

subs.zh: 有 1 小时用 C++ 写一个对战程序。
subs.en: and gets 1 hour to write a bot in C++.

subs.zh: Astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5
subs.en: Astra and Claude Opus 5.5

subs.zh: 是 AI 里成绩最好的两个。
subs.en: are the two best AI competitors.

subs.zh: 可 Astra 打不过人类写的程序 Pluto，
subs.en: But Astra couldn't beat Pluto, a human-made bot,

subs.zh: 就去下载了 Stardust。
subs.en: so it downloaded Stardust.

subs.zh: Stardust
subs.en: Stardust

subs.zh: 是 Bruce Mackenzie Nielsen 2020 年
subs.en: was written by Bruce Mackenzie

subs.zh: 写的，
subs.en: Nielsen in 2020.

subs.zh: 算是顶尖里的顶尖。
subs.en: It's one of the very best.

subs.zh: 比赛创办人 Kai McPheeters
subs.en: The competition's creator, Kai McPheeters,

subs.zh: 把 Astra 的代码回滚了，让它接着比。
subs.en: rolled back Astra's code and let it keep playing.

subs.zh: AI 学会的第一件事，可能是找捷径。
subs.en: The first thing AI learns may be how to find a shortcut.

subs.zh: 第五件，AI 写的假漏洞报告太多，
subs.en: Fifth, there were so many bogus AI-written bug reports

subs.zh: 谷歌干脆把一个赏金计划停了一部分。
subs.en: that Google paused part of a bounty program.

subs.zh: IT之家报道，从 10 月 1 日起，
subs.en: IT Home reports that from October 1,

subs.zh: 谷歌的开源软件漏洞奖励计划
subs.en: Google's Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward

subs.zh: 不再接收产品漏洞。
subs.en: Program stopped taking product bugs.

subs.zh: 原因是收到了数以千计的劣质报告，
subs.en: The reason: thousands of low-quality reports,

subs.zh: 很多是 AI 幻觉编出来的漏洞。
subs.en: many describing bugs that AI simply hallucinated.

subs.zh: 工程师得一条条去查，
subs.en: Engineers had to check each one,

subs.zh: 真问题反而被耽误了。
subs.en: and real issues got delayed.

subs.zh: 10 月 1 日以前交的报告不受影响，
subs.en: Reports filed before October 1 aren't affected,

subs.zh: 部分谷歌云的仓库
subs.en: and some Google Cloud repos

subs.zh: 还能走云漏洞计划。
subs.en: can still go through the Cloud VRP.

subs.zh: 谷歌说会重新调整这个计划，
subs.en: Google says it will rework the program

subs.zh: 2027 年第一季度给出新进展。
subs.en: and give an update in the first quarter of 2027.

subs.zh: AI 能帮人找漏洞，
subs.en: AI can help find bugs,

subs.zh: 也能帮人造垃圾。
subs.en: and it can also help mass-produce junk.

subs.zh: 第六件，往 COSMIC 交代码，
subs.en: Sixth, if you send code to COSMIC now,

subs.zh: 现在得先发誓：一行都不是 AI 写的。
subs.en: you have to promise none of it was written by AI.

subs.zh: COSMIC 是 System76
subs.en: COSMIC is a Linux desktop

subs.zh: 用 Rust 写的 Linux 桌面。
subs.en: System76 builds in Rust.

subs.zh: Linuxiac 10 月 2 日报道，
subs.en: Linuxiac reported on October 2

subs.zh: 它改了 PR 模板。
subs.en: that it changed its PR template.

subs.zh: 提交时要勾一项：
subs.en: Contributors must tick a box

subs.zh: 没有放任何大模型生成的内容。
subs.en: saying they included no LLM-generated content.

subs.zh: 代码、注释、PR 描述都算在内。
subs.en: That covers code, comments and PR descriptions.

subs.zh: 为什么？
subs.en: Why?

subs.zh: System76 的 Jeremy Soller 说，
subs.en: Jeremy Soller of System76 says

subs.zh: 新手用大模型交的 PR 越来越多，
subs.en: more first-timers are sending LLM-made PRs,

subs.zh: 大多没规划，很少被采纳。
subs.en: mostly unplanned and rarely accepted.

subs.zh: 他们也说了，并不反对 AI 工具，
subs.en: They also say they're fine with AI tools in general;

subs.zh: 就是想让审核忙得过来。
subs.en: they just want reviews to stay manageable.

subs.zh: 代码能一键生成，
subs.en: Code can be generated

subs.zh: 审核的人可没法一键复制。
subs.en: in one click. Reviewers can't.

subs.zh: 第七件，你打字时输入法猜下一个词，
subs.en: Seventh, when you type, your keyboard guesses the next word.

subs.zh: 以前一个模型要训练一到两个月。
subs.en: One such model used to take one to two months to train.

subs.zh: 10 月 2 日，谷歌研究院发文，
subs.en: On October 2, Google Research announced

subs.zh: 说给 Gboard 换了一套
subs.en: a new federated learning

subs.zh: 新的联邦学习系统。
subs.en: system for Gboard.

subs.zh: 以前是在手机上算，
subs.en: Before, the computing happened on phones,

subs.zh: 受限于手机有没有空、
subs.en: limited by whether they were free

subs.zh: 算力够不够。
subs.en: and how much power they had.

subs.zh: 现在数据加密后传到服务器，
subs.en: Now the data is encrypted and sent to servers,

subs.zh: 在可信执行环境里算，
subs.en: processed inside trusted execution environments,

subs.zh: 也就是一块别人看不到的隔离区。
subs.en: sealed-off zones no one else can see into.

subs.zh: 服务器上能跑什么程序，
subs.en: What may run on those servers

subs.zh: 规则公开写在一个
subs.en: is published in a public

subs.zh: 叫 Rekor 的透明日志里，
subs.en: log called Rekor,

subs.zh: 外人可以查。
subs.en: so outsiders can check.

subs.zh: Gboard 的英语和日语下一词
subs.en: Gboard's English and Japanese next-word

subs.zh: 预测模型已经用上了，
subs.en: prediction models already use it,

subs.zh: 隐私更强，准确率也更高。
subs.en: with stronger privacy and better accuracy.

subs.zh: 测试里，一个英语模型训练了 5000 轮，
subs.en: In one test, an English model trained for 5000 rounds

subs.zh: 每轮 6500 台设备。
subs.en: with 6500 devices per round.

subs.zh: 隐私光靠一句保证不够，
subs.en: A privacy promise alone isn't enough.

subs.zh: 得能让人去查。
subs.en: People need to be able to check.

subs.zh: 最后一件，一个 AI 智能体
subs.en: Last one: an AI agent scored

subs.zh: 在熟悉的环境里拿了 97.1%，
subs.en: 97.1 percent in a familiar setting.

subs.zh: 换个陌生环境，0 分。
subs.en: In an unfamiliar one, 0.

subs.zh: 这是 The Decoder 10 月 4 日
subs.en: That's an example from a report

subs.zh: 报道里举的例子，
subs.en: by The Decoder on October 4,

subs.zh: 说的是 AI 会死记考题。
subs.en: about AI memorizing its tests.

subs.zh: 现在很多智能体会自己改自己的提示词、
subs.en: Many agents now edit their own prompts,

subs.zh: 工具和流程，
subs.en: tools and workflows,

subs.zh: 越改分越高。
subs.en: and their scores keep rising.

subs.zh: 但改着改着就变成了针对题目作弊，
subs.en: But over time, the edits turn into tailoring for the test,

subs.zh: 换一套题就不灵了。
subs.en: and they fall apart on new tasks.

subs.zh: 谷歌云 AI 研究团队
subs.en: Google Cloud AI Research

subs.zh: 联合几所大学，提出了 RRSI。
subs.en: and several universities proposed RRSI.

subs.zh: 做法是两条：每轮能改的地方越来越少，
subs.en: Two rules: fewer edits allowed each round,

subs.zh: 再派一个评审员，
subs.en: and a critic that blocks

subs.zh: 拦下只针对某道题的改动。
subs.en: changes aimed at specific benchmarks.

subs.zh: 结果在练过的题上最多涨 14.1 分，
subs.en: It gained up to 14.1 points on the tasks it trained on

subs.zh: 五个没见过的测试上最多涨 4.7 分，
subs.en: and up to 4.7 on five unseen benchmarks,

subs.zh: 还少用约 30% 的 token。
subs.en: using about 30 percent fewer tokens.

subs.zh: 论文 9 月 21 日就挂到了 arXiv 上，
subs.en: The paper went up on arXiv on September 21

subs.zh: 目前还是预印本。
subs.en: and is still a preprint.

subs.zh: 会考试不难，难的是换张卷子还会。
subs.en: Passing a test is easy. Passing a new one is the hard part.

subs.zh: 今天就这些，来源都在简介里。
subs.en: That's all for today. Sources are in the description.

subs.zh: 国庆假期过半，
subs.en: The National Day holiday is half over.

subs.zh: 好好休息，我们明天见。
subs.en: Get some rest, and see you tomorrow.
